programs.name: Computing BEng
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum A*A*A or A*AAA, with A* in Mathematics; typical offer A*A*A* (three A-levels) or A*A*AA (four A-levels)
programs.ib_offer: Minimum 41 points, including 7 in Mathematics at Higher Level and 7 in another relevant Higher Level subject; typical offer 42 points
programs.ap_offer: Either 5,5,5,5,5 to include Calculus BC; or 5,5,5 to include Calculus BC together with an acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g. US High School Diploma) and either SAT 1480 or ACT 33.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A* at A-level; 7 at IB HL). Recommended: Computer Science, Physics, Further Mathematics
programs.toefl_note: Standard level: TOEFL iBT 92 overall with at least 20 in each element (tests before 21 Jan 2026, old 0-120 scale); 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in each element for tests from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale).
programs.english_note: Course requires the Standard university English level. Also accepted at that level: PTE Academic 62 (56 in all elements), Duolingo English Test 115 overall (105 in any integrated subscore).
programs.notes: Entry values and the GBP 47,800 overseas fee are for 2027 entry (October 2027 start). Interviews are not standard but may be offered at the admissions tutors' discretion. English: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/apply/english-language/ . Deadline: UCAS 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (Imperial institution code I50).

programs.name: Economics, Finance and Data Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum A*AA, with A* in Mathematics and AA in two other subjects; typical offer A*AA / A*A*A (three A-levels)
programs.ib_offer: Minimum 39 points, including 7 in Mathematics at Higher Level and 6 in each of two other Higher Level subjects; typical offer 39 points
programs.ap_offer: Either 5,5,5,5,4 to include 5 in Calculus BC; or 5,5,5 to include Calculus BC together with an acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g. US High School Diploma) and either SAT 1470 or ACT 32.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A* at A-level; 7 at IB HL). Further Mathematics and/or Economics useful but not required
programs.toefl_note: Higher level: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 22 in each element (tests before 21 Jan 2026, old 0-120 scale); 5.0 overall with at least 5.0 in each element for tests from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale).
programs.english_note: Course requires the Higher university English level. Also accepted at that level: PTE Academic 69 (62 in all elements), Duolingo English Test 125 overall (115 in any integrated subscore).
programs.notes: Delivered by Imperial Business School; this is the economics-type course chosen for Imperial (no pure Economics BSc). Entry values and the GBP 44,800 overseas fee are for 2027 entry (October 2027 start). English: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/apply/english-language/ . Deadline: UCAS 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (institution code I50).

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering MEng
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum A*A*A or A*AAA, with A* in Mathematics and A/A* in Physics (A* if three A-levels, at least A if four); typical offer A*A*A* (three A-levels) or A*A*AA (four A-levels)
programs.ib_offer: Minimum 40 points, including 6 in Mathematics and 6 in Physics at Higher Level; typical offer 40 points with 7 in Mathematics and 7 in Physics at Higher Level
programs.ap_offer: Either 5,5,5,5,5 to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics); or 5,5,5 to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics) together with an acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g. US High School Diploma) and either SAT 1480 or ACT 33.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics and Physics (A* in Mathematics at A-level; IB HL Mathematics and Physics)
programs.toefl_note: Standard level: TOEFL iBT 92 overall with at least 20 in each element (tests before 21 Jan 2026, old 0-120 scale); 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in each element for tests from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale).
programs.english_note: Course requires the Standard university English level. Also accepted at that level: PTE Academic 62 (56 in all elements), Duolingo English Test 115 overall (105 in any integrated subscore).
programs.notes: Values are for the main Mechanical Engineering MEng (H301); the page also lists year abroad / year in industry variants with the same codes. 2027 entry (October 2027 start); overseas fee GBP 47,800 per year as shown on the page (year abroad or industry placement years are charged differently, only Home-fee rates are shown on the page). English: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/apply/english-language/ . Deadline: UCAS 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (institution code I50).
